bio_en: Hakob Aslanian was one of the fighters of Shatakh, whose people, organised by Vardan, defended themselves against the Kurds for over a month in the Vaspurakan self-defence of 1896. He later served the ARF in the Persian border region. On 7 April 1903 he carried out the ARF Atrpatakan committee's sentence on Darmo, a former ARF soldier who had become a scourge of the people, in the cemetery of Mahlam in Salmast.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: low. #100 is mostly about the 1896 Shatakh battles; his own biography is thin in the portion read.
